chunks: My father, may Allah have mercy on him, said: Sa'd ibn Abdullah narrated to us, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah, who said: Al-'Awni al-Jawhari narrated to me, from Ibrahim al-Kufi, from a man from our companions, who ascribed it (to the Imam), saying:
Hasan ibn Ali (peace be upon them both) was asked about the intellect ('aql), so he said: Swallowing the lump (of anger/humiliation), and being accommodating with the enemies.

key_terms.التجرع: Swallowing/Gulping down (metaphor for enduring hardship or humiliation)
key_terms.للغصة: For the lump (referring to the lump in the throat from suppressed emotion or difficulty)

ai.seo_question: What is the definition of intellect (Aql) according to Imam Hasan (AS)?
ai.summary: In *Ma'ani al-Akhbar*, Shaykh al-Saduq records Imam Hasan (AS) defining intellect ('aql) as practical wisdom rather than mere cognition, emphasizing 'swallowing the lump' (enduring humiliation) and 'strategic accommodation' with enemies. This definition highlights the Shia emphasis on *hilm* (forbearance) and political pragmatism, where intellectual maturity is measured by one's ability to navigate adversity and secure peace through calculated patience rather than rigid pride.
